documents.text: Building notice WTR-612. Water service will be unavailable on Thursday from 9 AM until noon while the rooftop tank is cleaned. Store drinking water beforehand. This is planned maintenance, not an emergency leak.
queries: The note telling us to fill containers before they wash the building tank
WTR-612

documents.text: Plumbing invoice PLB-613. An emergency kitchen pipe leak was repaired on Monday. The call-out fee was 900 pesos and replacement fittings cost 350 pesos. Repairs carry a thirty-day workmanship guarantee.
queries: The bill for fixing the burst pipe under the kitchen sink
PLB-613

documents.text: Expense policy EXP-710. Taxi fares for approved client visits are reimbursed up to 600 pesos per trip. Attach the fare receipt and manager approval. Submit within ten business days. Daily commuting is excluded.
queries: Rules for claiming back cab money after visiting a customer
EXP-710

documents.text: Expense policy EXP-711. Meals during an approved overnight business trip are reimbursed up to 450 pesos per day. Itemized receipts are required. Alcohol and meals at the usual office are not reimbursable.
queries: What was the food allowance when we travelled overnight for work?
EXP-711

documents.text: Timesheet instruction TMS-901. Record hours by project code each Friday before 4 PM. A supervisor must approve overtime in advance. Corrections after submission go through the payroll administrator.
queries: The instructions about sending weekly hours before Friday afternoon
TMS-901

documents.text: Meeting room guide MTG-902. Reserve Cedar Room through the shared calendar. Capacity is eight people. Cancel unused reservations at least one hour before the start. The video-call adapter is kept in the cabinet.
queries: Where was the note about booking the room for eight people?
MTG-902

documents.text: Washing machine service note WSH-802. Clean the drain-pump filter when the machine fails to empty after a wash. Disconnect power first and place a shallow tray below the filter cover. Do not remove the drum assembly.
queries: Instructions for the laundry machine that leaves water inside
WSH-802

documents.text: Refrigerator service note FRG-803. If the freezer is cold but the fridge compartment is warm, keep the internal air vents clear of food containers. Check the door seal and allow space behind the appliance for ventilation.
queries: The advice for a fridge whose freezer still works but the food section is warm
FRG-803

documents.text: Seminar attendance record SEM-440. Mara attended the data ethics seminar on April 18. Completion required signing both morning and afternoon attendance sheets. A digital certificate is issued within five working days.
queries: Proof that Mara joined the session about responsible use of data
SEM-440

documents.text: Venue booking VEN-441. The training hall is booked for April 18 from 8 AM to 5 PM. It seats forty participants and includes a projector. The coordinator must return the key to reception before leaving.
queries: The booking for the training space with a projector and forty seats
VEN-441

documents.text: Parcel notice PCL-320. Package ZX-612 is ready for pickup at the neighborhood collection counter. Bring a photo ID and the pickup code. The counter closes at 7 PM. Collect within three days.
queries: Where is the message telling me to collect the package before the counter shuts?
PCL-320

documents.text: Parcel notice PCL-321. Delivery of package ZX-613 was attempted while nobody was home. Arrange another delivery date through the courier. No counter pickup is available for this parcel. A second attempt is free.
queries: The courier message saying they came when the house was empty
PCL-321

documents.text: Course change form CRS-530. Students may switch laboratory sections during the first week of classes if a seat is available. Obtain signatures from both instructors and submit to the registrar. This form does not withdraw a student from the course.
queries: The form for moving to a different lab class without dropping the subject
CRS-530

documents.text: Tuition payment guide FEE-531. Pay the second installment by May 12. Use the student number as the transfer reference. Email the bank transaction receipt to the finance office. A course-change form is not proof of payment.
queries: Instructions for identifying my tuition transfer and emailing the receipt
FEE-531

documents.text: Gym membership pause FRZ-220. Members can freeze their membership for up to thirty days while travelling. Request the pause three days before departure. The remaining paid days resume after the freeze period.
queries: How could I stop my gym days being used while I was away?
FRZ-220

documents.text: Gym membership cancellation CAN-221. Terminating an annual membership requires thirty days' written notice. The access card must be returned. Unused prepaid months are refunded after a 500-peso processing charge.
queries: The rules for ending the fitness contract and getting unused months refunded
CAN-221

documents.text: Internet service advisory NET-660. A damaged street cable caused loss of broadband in Block C. Repairs are expected by 6 PM. Keep the modem powered on so it reconnects when service is restored. Do not reset its saved configuration.
queries: The network message asking us to leave the modem on during street cable repairs
NET-660

documents.text: Internet transfer request MOV-661. To move broadband service to a new apartment, submit the new address and a copy of the lease at least seven days before relocation. Installation at the new address costs 1200 pesos.
queries: The instructions for taking my internet connection to a new flat
MOV-661

documents.text: Software handover HND-880. The nightly database export is encrypted and stored in the local backup folder. Recovery keys are held by the operations lead. After restoring an export, run the migration check before starting the dashboard. Deployments require a reviewed change request.
queries: The handover explaining what to check after restoring the dashboard database
HND-880

documents.text: Remote access guide VPN-881. If the VPN rejects your login after a password change, remove the saved credential and sign in again. Never email your password to support. Contact the service desk if multi-factor approval does not arrive.
queries: The help note for remote access refusing my new password
VPN-881
